description:
The generalized ANALYST BRIEF — one composed "how is <scope> doing right now?" picture (pulse + net direction,
    top_stories, winners/losers, aspect_heatmap, top_entities, top_assets) for any AND-combination of scopes. ⭐ Use to
    SUMMARIZE a scope (theme / news category / country / sector / aspect) — NOT a raw article list (that's
    search_news/news_feed). ⛔ NOT for a single COMPANY or market INDEX ("how is AAPL / the S&P doing?" →
    options_sentiment + stock_impact/news_feed; an index maps to an ETF, not a brief scope). For a sector×region the
    quickest path is pulse(kind='theme', target='banks', country=…); use brief for one precise GICS cohort or an AND-combo.
    Scope by ≥1 of (CSV for several) — REQUIRED (never whole-market):
      • `news_type` — a category; use ONLY these EXACT names: product_tech, ma_partnership, industry_thematic,
        earnings_results, corporate_action, management_governance, analyst_rating, macro_economic, geopolitics,
        commodity_supply, regulatory_legal, cybersecurity_digital_trust, digital_finance_tokenization,
        price_action_technical, crypto_related, forex_related, analyst_forecast. (commodity→commodity_supply;
        central-bank/rates→macro_economic — there is NO 'monetary_policy'.)
      • `country` (ISO-2) · `aspect` (impact channel) · `gics` (code or plain English) · `megatrend` (theme name/id).
    ⚠️ News coverage starts 2026-01-01. `node`+`ripple` appear only when a SINGLE megatrend anchors the brief.

aspect.description: Impact CHANNEL filter (e.g. `demand`, `competition`, `tariff`, `monetary`). Omit → all channels.
aspect.title: Aspect

country.description: Market filter — CSV of ISO-2 codes (e.g. `US` or `CN,TW,HK`). 🌍 If the question names a NATIONALITY or REGION ('European','Thai','Chinese','ASEAN'), put it HERE — never leave it inside a concept/`q`/`gics` field. Enumerate a region into its member ISO-2s yourself (Europe→GB,DE,FR,IT,ES,NL,CH,SE; ASEAN→TH,SG,MY,ID,PH,VN).
country.title: Country

from_.description: Lower time bound, ISO date `YYYY-MM-DD`. ⚠️ Ava Advisor NEWS coverage starts 2026-01-01 (nothing before).
from_.title: From

gics.description: A GICS sector/industry — a CODE PREFIX (sector `25` / group `2550` / industry `255010` / sub `25501010`, CSV for several) OR plain English ('banks', 'semiconductors', 'biotech'); the server resolves it. 🔴 ENGLISH (translate the concept first: ธนาคาร→'banks'). So 'European banks' = gics='banks' + country=EU codes.
gics.title: Gics

megatrend.description: A megatrend node — a name/slug (resolved for you, e.g. `foundry`) or an int node id. CSV for several.
megatrend.title: Megatrend

window.description: News-recency window: `7d`/`30d`/`90d`/`180d`/`1y` or `mtd`/`qtd`/`ytd`. Omit → a sensible default. (Price history is unaffected — this only scopes the NEWS lens.)
window.title: Window
